mapper.sql: SELECT d.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, e.ecn_no, ru.nickname AS release_by_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_attachment a WHERE a.biz_type = 'mes_doc' AND a.biz_id = d.id) AS file_count FROM mes_tech_doc d LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = d.material_id LEFT JOIN mes_ecn e ON e.id = d.ecn_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.id = d.release_by LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = d.create_by
mapper.select: WHERE d.doc_no = #{docNo} ORDER BY d.id DESC
